description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'BuzzLikeOnShareSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters related to likes on shares within the Buzz feature of the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes sorting and filtering capabilities specific to 'shareLike' entities.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering Buzz 'like' on share search results, with sorting options and a specific share ID filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search filter parameters with a default sort field 'shareLike.likedAtUtc'.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the current share ID filter value.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the share ID filter value.
